handbook-text:
Conquest Tweaks & Compatibility
Tune the Conquest look, and fix it up alongside other mods

This companion mod turns Conquest's retextures back to the game's original art on a per-family basis, adds a green-selective "vibrancy" dial for toning down foliage, and applies compatibility fixes for supported mods when they're detected. Changes are baked in when the world loads, so edit a setting, then relog to see it.

Commands (type in chat; mind the leading period)
• .cvv list — show which texture each surface uses (vanilla or conquest) and the vibrancy settings.
• .cvv set [name] vanilla|conquest — choose the texture for a surface. Example: .cvv set stonepath conquest
• .cvv vibrancy [0..1] — green saturation multiplier: 1.0 leaves it unchanged, 0.8 is the default gentle knock-down, ~0.6 is stronger, 0.1 is nearly grey.
• .cvv scan — list any blocks rendering the pink/black placeholder and write a report.

Surfaces you can switch
Vanilla by default: soil, grasscover (the grass-block top-cover), forestfloor, clay, farmland, stonepath.
Conquest by default: peat, cob, rammedearth, mudbrick (earthy building materials), plus tallgrass and otherfoliage. Conquest heavily restructured foliage, so these revert only partially — the vibrancy dial below is usually the better tool for "plants are too green".

Vibrancy dial
Desaturates only the green of the plant tint, leaving dry, brown and autumn tones alone. The game tints grass, ferns, bushes and tree leaves from the same colormap, so this tones down all foliage green together.

Config file
Everything the commands change — plus advanced hue-band and brightness knobs — lives in ModConfig/conquestvanillavom.json.

Compatibility fixes
When a supported mod is detected, its fix activates automatically — no setup. Run .cvv list to see which fixes are active. Currently supported:
• Visible Ores & Minerals — repairs the 3D ore veins that would otherwise show the pink/black placeholder.
• Terrain Slabs — makes Conquest's connected textures line up on slabs (the game otherwise picks a random tile for slab-shaped blocks). Toggle with EnableSlabsFix in the config.
